resources.string-array:
PLACEHOLDER: Gather all trash into a trash bag.
PLACEHOLDER: Gather all recyclable items into a recycle container.
PLACEHOLDER: Find and remove all dishes, glasses, silverware, etc. Move it all to the sink for now.
PLACEHOLDER: Pick up every item of dirty clothing and move it to the designated laundry container.
PLACEHOLDER: Scan the room and collect all clutter— this means anything that is not furniture or a permanent part of the room, whether it belongs there or not. Put everything in the same container for now.
PLACEHOLDER: Wipe down all horizontal surfaces. Depending on your floor type, sweep, mop, or vacuum.
PLACEHOLDER: Time to return everything to its home. Go through the clutter container one item at a time, starting with items that live in this room. Then return items that live in other rooms.
resources.string: Does your space ever feel like this?
You recognize all the individual shapes
but together, it\'s a chaotic mess.
What if we skip the linear approach and find a single-focus?
"Your mess is not invincible. \n\nYou just need the right strategy."
"Sweep helps you tackle any space by breaking down your cleaning routine into single-focus passes. \n\nThe steps are simple."
"Forget about perfection. \n\nThis is about taking that first step and harnessing your momentum."
